name: phase-out-videodl-direct-ytdlp
title: Phase out videodl with strengthened direct scripts and yt-dlp fallback
creator: Mabel
notes: Phase 0 observability landed with DownloadTrace taxonomy and baseline template. Hotfixes completed for yt-dlp/videodl sidecar wrappers, YouTube runtime stability, default videodl-off testing gate, and direct-download cancellation UX correctness. Phase 1 direct candidate contract hardening landed: extension now sends optional videoCandidates, backend selects safe direct candidate for Douyin/XHS, and non-direct candidate cases fallback to smart router by pageUrl. Phase 2 core hardening landed in backend: candidate policy (cache -> videoUrl -> videoCandidates), one-step direct retry, smart fallback by pageUrl, and stage-oriented trace/error reporting. Phase 3 routing migration landed with yt-dlp-first policy and hidden canary videodl fallback switch. Phase 4 readiness tooling added via .trellis/scripts/download_trace_report.py for 3-day baseline and 7-day deletion-gate report generation from DownloadTrace logs.
